title: Mastering Model Fit: Applications of the InterModel Vigorish for Interpretable Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29960v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accuracy alone gives little information about which features or model components improve probabilistic fit, which outcomes benefit, or how fit changes during training. We introduce the InterModel Vigorish (IMV) into the Machine Intelligence space in order to express differences in fit as an expected betting advantage over a reference model. SHAP-IMV attributes gains to features through Shapley-weighted subset comparisons, Multi-IMV evaluates one-vs-rest and pairwise class discrimination, and Ablate-IMV assesses architectural components and feature groups by ablation. We evaluate these applications over ten random seeds using tabular data, images, sensor sequences, and graphs. Feature rankings vary across estimators. High one-vs-rest accuracy can accompany negligible improvement over a null, while ablation can preserve or improve fit under a fixed training budget. translated_title: 掌握模型拟合：InterModel Vigorish（模型间赌利）在可解释机器学习中的应用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.29960v1 公告类型：交叉。仅有准确率几乎无法说明哪些特征或模型组件改善了概率拟合、哪些结果从中受益，以及拟合在训练过程中如何变化。我们将模型间赌利（InterModel Vigorish, IMV）引入机器智能领域，以将拟合差异表达为相对于参考模型的期望投注优势。SHAP-IMV 通过 Shapley 加权的子集比较将增益归因于各个特征，Multi-IMV 评估一对多及成对的类别判别能力，Ablate-IMV 则通过消融评估架构组件和特征组。我们使用表格数据、图像、传感器序列和图数据，在十个随机种子上对这些应用进行了评估。结果显示，特征排序在不同估计器之间存在差异；一对多准确率很高时，相对于零基准的改进却可能微不足道；而在固定训练预算下，消融可以保持甚至改善拟合。在六个图分类基准上，我们对 IMV 进行了超过 200 个训练（周期）的时序剖析……
tldr: 本文将“模型间赌利（IMV）”引入机器学习领域，通过 SHAP-IMV、Multi-IMV 和 Ablate-IMV 等可解释工具，将模型拟合差异量化为相对于参考模型的期望投注优势，从而揭示哪些特征、模型组件和训练阶段真正改善了概率拟合。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the InterModel Vigorish (IMV) into machine learning, providing interpretable tools (SHAP-IMV, Multi-IMV, and Ablate-IMV) that quantify differences in model fit as an expected betting advantage over a reference model, revealing which features, model components, and training stages genuinely improve probabilistic fit.
